findings.title: Revoke the new evaluation completion receipt when final readback fails
findings.requirement: task-d-brief.md:71 and77-81 require no successful gating receipt after final readback/report publication failure, while preserving the frozen model selection.
findings.detail: The evaluator exclusively publishes evaluation-complete.json, then calls _evaluation_readback(). If this last artifact readback raises, the handler writes failure.json but leaves the newly published success receipt. The existing-output path checks only completion/start/artifact bindings and ignores the failure disposition. A subsequent invocation therefore returns exploratory_evaluation_complete once a transient read failure clears.
findings.reproduction: Using only fresh synthetic fixtures and SyntheticBackend, inject a one-shot OSError in dataset.sha256(report.json) when evaluation-complete.json already exists. The exception is reached at _evaluation_readback line104 after publication, not during setup. Both failure.json and evaluation-complete.json survive; a later exact-target invocation returns success with zero backend loads.
findings.impact: A failed evaluation attempt becomes a successful gating record even though the required final verification did not succeed. This does not cause new test inference on retry, but violates the explicit fail-closed evidence contract and contradicts the documented no-completion-on-failure claim.
findings.recommendation: In an authorized repair, make the new evaluation publication plus final artifact readback one fail-closed transaction: invalidate only that attempt's newly published completion marker on failure, retain start/predictions/pending/failure evidence and the preexisting frozen selection, and permanently test failure-after-publication plus subsequent-call non-gating behavior. Do not reopen test inference or erase historical artifacts.
